```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 10,
  fig.height = 6,
  dpi = 150
)

# dealing with sf package issues
proj_data <- file.path(dirname(dirname(R.home())), "share", "proj")
if (Sys.getenv("PROJ_DATA") == "" && dir.exists(proj_data)) {
  Sys.setenv(PROJ_DATA = proj_data)
}

# packages
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(sf)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)


# setting theme: 
theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      legend.position = "bottom",

)


user_name <- Sys.getenv("USER", unset = Sys.info()[["user"]])
repo_dir <- Sys.getenv("RAINFALL_MORTALITY_REPO")
if (repo_dir == "") repo_dir <- file.path("/project/cil/home_dirs", user_name, "repos/rainfall-mortality-2026")
source(file.path(repo_dir, "1_data/mortality_data/1_cleaning/PHL/paths.R"))

shape_dir <- file.path(

  "PH_Adm3_MuniCities.shp"
)

rate_files <- c(adm3_total = file.path(death_rates_dir, "adm3_year_total.csv"),

                national_sex = file.path(death_rates_dir, "national_year_sex.csv"),
                national_age_broad = file.path(death_rates_dir, "national_year_age_broad.csv"),

    death_rates_dir, "national_year_age_standard.csv"),

cause_summary_file <- file.path(

)


# Read rate tables and cause summaries:
adm3_total <- fread(

national_sex <- fread(rate_files["national_sex"], showProgress = FALSE) %>%

as_tibble()
```

# Overview

All rates use place of residence and resident population. Rates are deaths per 100,000 unless stated otherwise.

```{r overview-table}
# Combine annual totals with sex- and age-specific rates
year_summary <- national_total %>%
  select(year, deaths, population, crude_rate = death_rate_per_100000) %>%
  left_join(
    national_sex %>%
      select(year, sex, death_rate_per_100000) %>%
      mutate(sex = paste0(sex, "_rate")) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = sex, values_from = death_rate_per_100000),
    by = "year"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    national_age_broad %>%
      select(year, age_group_broad, death_rate_per_100000) %>%
      mutate(
        age_group_broad = recode(
          age_group_broad,
          "0-4" = "age_0_4_rate",
          "5-64" = "age_5_64_rate",
          "65+" = "age_65_plus_rate"
        )
      ) %>%
      pivot_wider(
        names_from = age_group_broad,
        values_from = death_rate_per_100000
      ),
    by = "year"
  ) %>%
  arrange(year)

# Format for display
year_summary %>%
  mutate(
    deaths = comma(deaths),
    population = comma(round(population)),
    across(ends_with("_rate"), ~ number(.x, accuracy = 0.1))
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c(
      "Year", "Deaths", "Population",
      "Crude rate", "Female rate",
      "Male rate", "0–4 rate", "5–64 rate",
      "65+ rate"
    ),
    align = "rrrrrrrrr"
  )
```

# National trends

```{r national-rate}
national_rate_plot <- ggplot(
  national_total,
  aes(year, death_rate_per_100000)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9, color = "#2f5d62") +
  geom_point(size = 1.8, color = "#2f5d62") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2006, 2024, by = 2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(
    title = "National death rate",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Deaths per 100,000"
  )

national_rate_plot
```

```{r national-deaths-population}
national_long <- national_total %>%
  select(year, deaths, population) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(deaths, population),
    names_to = "series",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(series = recode(series, deaths = "Deaths", population = "Population"))

national_deaths_population_plot <- ggplot(
  national_long,
  aes(year, value, color = series)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~series, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2006, 2024, by = 2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  guides(color = "none") +
  labs(title = "Deaths and population", x = NULL, y = NULL)

national_deaths_population_plot
```

```{r standard-age-heatmap}
standard_age_levels <- c(
  "0", "1-4", "5-14", "15-24", "25-34", "35-44",
  "45-54", "55-64", "65-74", "75-79", "80+"
)

standard_age_rates <- national_age_standard %>%
  mutate(
    age_group_standard = factor(
      age_group_standard,
      levels = standard_age_levels
    )
  )

standard_age_heatmap <- ggplot(
  standard_age_rates,
  aes(
    year,
    age_group_standard,
    fill = death_rate_per_100000
  )
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(2006, 2024, by = 2),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "magma",
    direction = -1,
    labels = comma,
    name = "Deaths per 100,000"
  ) +
  labs(title = "Death rate by age group", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

standard_age_heatmap
```

# Monthly rates

The monthly rate is annualized using the number of days in each month and year.

```{r monthly-rate-heatmap}
monthly_rates <- national_month_age_broad %>%
  mutate(
    age_group_broad = factor(
      age_group_broad,
      levels = c("0-4", "5-64", "65+")
    ),
    month_date = as.Date(sprintf("%d-%02d-01", year, month))
  )

monthly_rate_heatmap <- ggplot(
  monthly_rates,
  aes(
    month_date,
    age_group_broad,
    fill = annualized_rate_per_100000_person_years
  )
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.12) +
  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "2 years",
    date_labels = "%Y",
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "magma",
    direction = -1,
    labels = comma,
    name = "Annualized rate"
  ) +
  labs(title = "Monthly death rate by broad age group", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

monthly_rate_heatmap
```

# ADM3 maps

```{r read-adm3-shape, include=FALSE}
adm3_shape <- st_read(
  shape_dir,
  layer = "PH_Adm3_MuniCities.shp",
  quiet = TRUE
) %>%
  mutate(
    shp_adm3_code = str_pad(
      str_replace_all(as.character(adm3_psgc), "[^0-9]", ""),
      width = 10,
      side = "left",
      pad = "0"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(shp_adm3_code, geometry)
```

```{r static-map, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
map_years <- c(2006, 2015, 2020, 2024)

map_data <- adm3_shape %>%
  left_join(
    adm3_total %>%
      filter(year %in% map_years) %>%
      select(
        year,
        shp_adm3_code,
        population,
        deaths,
        death_rate_per_100000
      ),
    by = "shp_adm3_code"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(year))

# Cap only the color scale. The underlying rates are unchanged.
map_cap <- quantile(
  map_data$death_rate_per_100000,
  0.99,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

ggplot(map_data) +
  geom_sf(
    aes(fill = pmin(death_rate_per_100000, map_cap)),
    color = NA
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~year, ncol = 2) +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE, datum = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "magma",
    direction = -1,
    labels = comma,
    name = "Deaths per 100,000",
    na.value = "grey90"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "ADM3 residence death rates",
    subtitle = "Color scale capped at the 99th percentile"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```
